what_this_is: A made-up provider description for the start-a-computer tests (example.test answers nothing).
name: Example Test Cloud

find_servers_by_name.notes: The servers with one exact name, with labels and public address. Reads only.

create_server.notes: Rent one server. Billed from the moment it exists, so look for one with the name first.

read_server.notes: One server with its labels and address. Read it before removing it.

delete_server.notes: Remove one server and its disk; it cannot be undone.

find_ssh_key_by_fingerprint.notes: The stored SSH key with one exact fingerprint, if any. Reads only.

add_ssh_key.notes: Store one public SSH key for new servers.

read_ssh_key.notes: One stored SSH key with its labels.

delete_ssh_key.notes: Remove one stored SSH key; servers already made keep it.

read_size_price.notes: One server type with its price in every location. Reads only.

power_off_server.notes: Hard power-off of one server (the provider cuts its power). Answers its action: wait for it.

change_server_type.notes: Change one server to another type. Needs the server off. upgrade_disk false keeps its disk: the type changes in place. Answers its action.

power_on_server.notes: Power one server on. Answers its action: wait for it.

read_action.notes: One action with its status (running, success or error). Reads only.

resize.notes: Change a rented server to another type of the same provider, keeping its disk. In order: power_off_server, change_server_type, power_on_server; each answers an action (at action_at) that is polled with read_action until its status (status_at) is action_words.done (a failed action or an exhausted bound ends the wait). The server's type sits at type_at of the host read; running_state is the status it must have before and after. Every wait is at most tries more polls, every_ms apart.
